## Purpose

Populate ROS forms from ObServe data, with **one ROS workbook per selected trip**.

This document records the agreed design and the decisions to settle before implementation.

Field-level mappings belong in separate documents, one per ROS sheet.

## Scope

The first target is ObServe **10.0**, longline observations, and ROS LL **4.2.0**.

ObServe source versions use major.minor. ROS target versions retain their own version numbering.

The design must also support purse-seine exports, with separate LL and PS mappings.
